entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate item-modeling reference, not an accepted asset or runtime icon.
Input image 1 is a PRIVATE original inventory sprite supplied only as silhouette, color and surface-layout reference. Reconstruct its recognizable design in NEW detailed HD imagery; NEVER paste, reproduce or include the pixel sprite anywhere on the board.
Make a clean professional technical turnaround board of ONE shield: FRONT, SIDE, BACK and THREE-QUARTER views plus a small NEW HD inventory-composition thumbnail of exactly the SAME object. All five depictions must share geometry, face design, thickness, materials and scale. SIDE must show the same front curvature and boss depth; BACK is the real reverse face, not another decorated front. Show a plausible separate grip/attachment on the back only, without any hand or body; rear grip, hidden construction, thickness and scale are explicitly proposed reconstruction. Front design must follow the source.
Plain charcoal-gray background, generous spacing, full shield visible in each view, neutral soft studio illumination, restrained realistic dark medieval materials with fine wear. Color comes from materials/paint, no glow, colored lighting or painted floor shadows. No scenery, character, weapon, pedestal, exploded variants or ornamental additions. Crisp modern HD rendering throughout, including the thumbnail. Only minimal labels: item name, FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3/4, ICON.
Subject: item.design.base.buckler. Original inventory cursor 83.
BUCKLER. Preserve the small ROUND compact all-metal shield in the reference: very dark blackened iron/steel face, large central rounded domed steel boss, narrow dark metal outer rim and a ring of small spaced rounded metal studs on the surrounding face. Subtle concentric incised/curving ironwork follows the source rather than a heraldic symbol. The brightest muted steel catches are on the upper/right rim and boss; this remains a dark iron material under neutral light. No wood face, painted colors, lion, gold crest, spikes, tall kite outline or oversized boss. Back is dark forged metal with a believable compact transverse grip behind the central boss; do not put a second front boss on the reverse.

reference.notes: Original licensed inventory sprite inspected at nearest-neighbor 6x enlargement; only its hash and cursor are published.

Grip, forearm strap and attachment placement
Material thickness, curvature depth and absolute real-world scale
Fine fasteners, wear and details not resolved by the original pixels

Subject: item.design.base.kite-shield. Original inventory cursor 113.
KITE SHIELD. Preserve the source's elongated kite outline: broad upper shoulders, near-flat/slightly sloping top, long straight taper into a sharp lower point, subtly convex face. The essential heraldic painted front is QUARTERED: upper LEFT deep cobalt BLUE, upper RIGHT bright golden YELLOW, lower LEFT golden YELLOW, lower RIGHT cobalt BLUE, with a small plain silver-gray hemispherical boss centered at the intersection. Each quarter contains a subtle same-family darker/tonal heraldic rampant-lion silhouette, positioned and oriented like the source, not a new eagle or cross. Keep the vivid blue/yellow identity as realistic pigment over a wooden shield, not glow or neon; yellow is painted ochre/golden yellow, not giant polished gold-metal panels. No added thick metal quadrant divider, spikes, ornate border or extra bosses. Proposed back shows warm wood backing, modest leather forearm strap and grip, with the same pointed outline; do not repeat the four colored front quarters on the reverse.

entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this KITE SHIELD concept turnaround board, candidate revision r1.
Change ONLY the central SIDE-view shield drawing, especially the extra silver hemisphere protruding to its LEFT at the boss height. The SIDE drawing currently incorrectly shows a front metal boss on both faces.

Remove the extra LEFT silver dome and replace that small region with the dark rear wooden surface/edge and a modest brown leather wrapped grip profile consistent with the grip already shown in BACK. Keep the full FRONT, BACK, 3/4 and ICON depictions exactly unchanged: same outline, shoulder notches, blue/yellow quarter order, four tonal lions, front steel boss, material wear, grip layout, scale, neutral lighting and charcoal background.
